name: Rod of Metamagic, Burninggreater
body:
Metamagic Rods | Other Rods
Rod of Metamagic, Burning
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 187
Aura strong (no school) CL 17th
Slot none; Price 9,000 gp (lesser), 32,500 gp (normal), 73,000 gp (greater); Weight 5 lbs.
Description
The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that deal extra acid or fire damage as though using the Burning Spell feat (Ultimate Magic).
Construction
Requirements Craft Rod, Burning Spell; Cost 4,500 gp (lesser), 16,250 gp (normal), 36,500 gp (greater)
